description: TraceGuard scoring penalty rules. Score starts at 100; penalties are subtracted. Each category has a maximum penalty cap.

insecureTransport.description: Penalty for insecure HTTP requests (mixed content, non-HTTPS subresources)

thirdPartyCookies.description: Penalty for third-party persistent cookies (cross-site tracking indicator)

thirdPartyConcentration.description: Penalty based on the ratio of third-party to total requests

cookieConfiguration.description: Penalty for cookies missing HttpOnly, Secure flags, or with SameSite=None
cookieConfiguration.notes: Counted per misconfigured cookie, capped at maxPenalty

privacyPermissions.description: Penalty for privacy-sensitive browser permission grants

storageAndOther.description: Penalty for storage indicators and other minor observations
